owner.meaning: address of the single configured owner of the vault
owner.evidence: The vault stores one configured owner address. A caller whose address differs from the configured owner address can call withdraw. The intended authorization rule is that a withdrawal may complete only when the caller address equals the configured owner address. Because the withdrawal path omits this authorization check, the unauthorized call completes successfully instead of reverting.
